text:
incident-bot: Pager: HIGH severity - Umbra Corp (private VPC) authentication failures on dedicated pool umbra-prod-1. Error rate spike from 00:02 UTC. @oncall-sre Sam.Henderson paging.

sam.henderson: I’m on it. seeing 502s at the auth-bridge layer for tenant umb-42, intermittent. hitting jwks validation errors in logs.

evie.chen: grabbing auth-bridge logs now. can you prod logs with tenant id?

sam.henderson: running quick check: `kubectl -n vpc-auth get pods -l app=auth-bridge` then `kubectl logs auth-bridge-0 -c bridge --since=15m | grep umb-42`

ejecmd: command output snippet pasted below.

sam.henderson: log snippet: ```
2026-03-14T00:01:53Z ERROR validation_failed tenant=umb-42 jwks_kid=abc123 reason=certificate_expired
2026-03-14T00:01:53Z WARN token_reject tenant=umb-42 subject=svc-client-1 err="EKU mismatch or expired cert"
```

jordan.kim: Umbra said they rotated their edge certs last night but didn't push to their identity proxy. looks like our bridge rejects because cert chain is stale / EKU doesn't match.

nilesh.patel: confirming from Umbra: we rolled certs but our internal idp-proxy was still using old cert (we had a failed restart). we're on the phone with infra now.

sam.henderson: impact: 30% of requests from Umbra failing auth -> customer-facing latency & error spikes. Not global. Affects dedicated pool umbra-prod-1.

evie.chen: immediate mitigations we can do from our side: 1) temporarily route umb-42 to fallback auth path that uses cached JWKS (read-only) for 10m 2) increase logs for tenant 3) request Umbra to restart their idp-proxy.

jordan.kim: prefer option 1 + ask Umbra to rotate properly. fallback path is lower security for a short window but is scoped to umb-42 only. Need IC signoff.

sam.henderson: IC (me) authorizes scoped fallback for 15 minutes. Prepare playbook.

evie.chen: executing change: `kubectl exec -n vpc-auth config-router -- sh -c "route set --tenant umb-42 --auth-mode=cached-jwks --expires=15m"`

evie.chen: change applied. routing table now shows umb-42 -> auth-bridge (cached jwks). confirm?

sam.henderson: running synthetic: `curl -H 'Authorization: Bearer <umb-token>' https://umbra.api/health -v` -> auth passes, 200 OK. Errors dropping.

jordan.kim: pushing note to umbrella ops: "We enabled a short-lived cached-JWKS fallback for tenant umb-42 to restore traffic. This is time-limited and scoped. Please restart your idp-proxy and confirm new cert chain distribution."

nilesh.patel: restarting idp-proxy now. will report when done. ETA ~4m.

alice.moreno: adding alert suppression for false positives in our dashboards for this tenant while fallback is active. will annotate incident.

sam.henderson: monitoring in progress. errors dropped from 32% -> 2% in 2m after change.

evie.chen: logs show: ```
2026-03-14T00:04:12Z INFO auth_fallback tenant=umb-42 mode=cached_jwks note="fallback enabled by IC sam.henderson"
2026-03-14T00:05:30Z INFO auth_success tenant=umb-42 subject=svc-client-1
```

nilesh.patel: idp-proxy restart completed, verifying JWKS endpoint now returns updated keys and cert chain OK. `curl https://idp.umbra.internal/.well-known/jwks.json | jq .keys[0].kid` -> abc123 (new)

jordan.kim: great. please confirm token validation locally with new certs.

nilesh.patel: verified. Umbra reissued tokens and tests green. They will keep an eye for 30m.

sam.henderson: rolling back fallback now. `route unset --tenant umb-42 --auth-mode=cached-jwks` then reload routing.

evie.chen: rollback applied. running synthetic again. `curl -H 'Authorization: Bearer <umb-new-token>' https://umbra.api/health -v` -> 200 OK.

alice.moreno: updating customer comms: posted to Umbra channel: "We observed auth failures caused by a stale cert in your idp-proxy. We enabled a short-lived cached-JWKS fallback to restore traffic; you restarted your proxy and new tokens validated. Recommend full cert rollout and a restart verification. We're available if you need deeper forensics." :white_check_mark: 

jordan.kim: postmortem items: - add a playbook to detect mismatch between JWKS kid and deployed cert - automate tenant-scoped fallback with stricter audit trail - add runbook step to verify idp-proxy restart at customer end

sam.henderson: handoff to day SRE: @evie.chen taking 08:00-16:00 shift. checklist for handoff posted: current status = resolved, monitoring windows open for 60m, customer notified, logs archived.

evie.chen: taking handoff. will watch for regressions and confirm cleared after 60m.

incident-bot: Note: incident created INC-2026-0314-umbra-auth-01, severity reduced to LOW at 00:18 UTC per IC. Handoff recorded.

sam.henderson: closing thread after postmortem draft. will attach logs & command snippets to INC ticket. thanks all. :thumbsup:

alice.moreno: quick follow-up: please add Umbra to the yearly VPC auth workshop schedule; they had a partial automation gap.

evie.chen: noted. adding to backlog and scheduling a short sync with Umbra ops next week.

sam.henderson: end of thread.
